column1: #mapping_set_description: 'Sequence dictionary served with each iGenomes FASTA (genome.dict; Homo_sapiens_assembly38.dict for GATK builds): SAM header @HD and @SQ lines (SAM spec, hts-specs). One record per @SQ line; @HD values are repeated on each record under ''@HD/<tag>'' keys.'

column9: Lossy: Records where the dict was built (often another machine), not where the FASTA is now.
